items.title: Abuse of Cloud-Native Infrastructure in Modern Phishing Campaigns - CYFIRMA
items.excerpt: Attackers increasingly leverage cloud-native services like serverless functions and object storage to host phishing pages, bypassing traditional domain blacklists. This report details infrastructure patterns, detection signatures, and mitigation strategies for defenders managing hybrid cloud environments.

items.title: GhostCode attackers abuse device codes to take over Microsoft 365 accounts
items.excerpt: The GhostCode threat group exploits Microsoft 365 device code authentication flows to bypass multi-factor authentication. This article explains the attack chain, token persistence techniques, and infrastructure-level controls to restrict device code usage and detect anomalous OAuth activity.

items.title: Inside an AI‑enabled device code phishing campaign
items.excerpt: Microsoft researchers dissect a campaign using AI-generated prompts to guide victims through device code authentication. The report highlights behavioral indicators, AI prompt engineering tactics, and identity protection policies to mitigate automated credential theft in enterprise environments.

items.title: SideWinder APT Credential Harvesting Campaign — PaaS Platform Abuse at Scale
items.excerpt: SideWinder APT abuses Platform-as-a-Service offerings to host credential harvesting infrastructure at scale. The analysis details deployment patterns, DNS tunneling techniques, and cloud security posture management strategies to identify and dismantle malicious PaaS workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Teams Phishing via Fake IT Helpdesk Impersonation (External Chat, Vishing, Screen Sharing, RMM
items.excerpt: Threat actors impersonate IT support within Microsoft Teams to trick employees into sharing credentials or granting remote access via RMM tools. The analysis covers external chat exploitation, screen-sharing abuse, and defensive configurations for Teams and endpoint management.

items.title: n8n Weaponized for Phishing and Device Fingerprinting
items.excerpt: Open-source workflow automation tool n8n is being repurposed to orchestrate phishing campaigns and collect device fingerprints. Researchers outline how attackers deploy self-hosted n8n instances to automate credential harvesting and evade detection, with recommendations for network monitoring.

items.title: Device Code Phishing: How EvilTokens Hit 12,000+ Inboxes
items.excerpt: EvilTokens leverages device code phishing to harvest long-lived access tokens, impacting thousands of organizations. The breakdown covers email delivery mechanisms, token validation bypasses, and infrastructure defender playbooks for monitoring Azure AD sign-in logs and revoking compromised sessions.

items.title: Capacity Enhancement Guide: Counter-Phishing Recommendations for Federal Agencies
items.excerpt: CISA’s comprehensive guide outlines architectural and operational controls to counter phishing threats across federal networks. It covers email filtering enhancements, identity hardening, incident response workflows, and continuous monitoring frameworks tailored for critical infrastructure defenders.
